scope: Guest calls for D3D10CreateBlob, D3D12GetDebugInterface and four legacy DXGIX exports, plus their name and ordinal lookups.
debug: Repeated factory and interface queries return the same Xbox object. A rejected IUnknown query preserves the output. The second table implements the observed constant reference counts. Setting the flags through the first table updates the masked process getter.
blob: Create, query ID3DBlob, write and read 257 bytes, AddRef and release to zero. The provider forwards to D3DCreateBlob in d3dcompiler_47.
legacy_dxgix: The Series DLL aliases DXGIXGetFrameStatistics, DXGIXPresentArray, DXGIXSetFrameNotification and DXGIXSetVLineNotification. All return DXGI_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED for null arguments and for pointers to a guarded value.
reference_setup: App-local d3d12_xs.dll and xgs12_10.dll from the Series package, plus TuxBox xmem.dll. The control pins the UMD for the lifetime of its blob.

checks.receipt: xmem-default: PASS (allocator pairs 1/6 and 2/7, ordinary and 64 KiB allocations, host working set v2, virtual reserve/commit)
